scene.ko: 친구가 데려간 태국 음식점에서 서로 음식을 나눠 먹으며 맛을 이야기한다.

lines.en: So, how's your curry? Is it too spicy?
No, it's perfect. It's spicy, but a little sweet, too.
lines.ko: 아니, 딱 좋아. 매운데 살짝 달기도 해.
alt: Not at all. It's spicy and a bit sweet at the same time.
It's just right. Spicy, but also kind of sweet.

lines.en: Right? That's the coconut milk. Here, try my soup.
lines.ko: 그치? 그게 코코넛 밀크 맛이야. 자, 내 수프도 먹어 봐.

lines.en: Wow, it's really sour, in a good way. It kind of reminds me of kimchi stew.
lines.ko: 와, 엄청 새콤하다, 좋은 쪽으로. 약간 김치찌개 생각나.
alt: Mmm, it's pretty sour, but I like it. It reminds me a little of kimchi stew.

lines.en: Ha, I can see that. What about the noodles?
lines.ko: 하하, 그럴 수도 있겠다. 국수는 어때?

lines.en: They're a bit too salty for me, but the peanuts are a nice touch.
lines.ko: 나한테는 좀 짜긴 한데, 땅콩 들어간 건 좋다.
alt: They're kind of salty for me, but I like the peanuts.
A little too salty, but the peanuts are great.

lines.en: Yeah, I always ask for less sauce. Told you this place was good, though!
lines.ko: 응, 난 항상 소스 적게 해 달라고 해. 그래도 여기 맛있다고 했잖아!

lines.en: You were right. I'm definitely coming back here.
lines.ko: 네 말이 맞았어. 여기 꼭 다시 올 거야.
alt: You were totally right. I'll definitely come back.
Yeah, you were right. Let's come here again.

expressions.note: 부정적으로 들릴 수 있는 말 뒤에 붙임
입에 안 맞는 점을 부드럽게 말할 때
